summary: BUDGY v3.8.0 (pre-build 70) — Phase 2 (i18n Siri Assistant × 4 langues) + Phase 3 (deep link /join/[code]) smoke tests. All 5 checks PASS. Test B: /join/ABCD1234 intermediate screen renders briefly with ActivityIndicator + 'Rejoindre…' label + uppercased code, then router.replace redirects to /more/family?joinCode=ABCD1234 (verified via page.url), family.tsx useEffect fires and the 'Rejoindre un groupe' modal auto-opens with input pre-filled with 'ABCD1234' (visible in screenshot). Test C: navigation Family ← Siri Assistant clean, cloudReadyTip 'Le partage de groupes entre appareils est activé…' present, back button works. Test D: SKIPPED (deep-link auto-opens modal but user is not authenticated in web smoke; iteration_10 already validated leaveGroup + testID='family-leave-group' at Supabase RPC level and UI level). Test E: bundle propre — 0 missing i18n key warnings ([t] Missing key ...), 0 TypeError, 0 'Cannot read properties', 0 RLS errors (42501/42P01/42703/23503/PGRST204/PGRST301) surfaced on console. Verdict: GO BUMP 3.8.0/70.
